C1238.title: TransUnion Reports More Than $3.3 Billion in U.S. Synthetic Identity Exposure
C1238.summary: On September 17, 2025, TransUnion reported that U.S. lenders had more than $3.3 billion in exposure tied to suspected synthetic identities in newly opened accounts for the year ending 2024. The research examined identity traits and behavioral clues in public records to identify applications assembled from data that appears individually valid and described a corresponding detection model.
